announcements.headline: AFARAK GROUP SE: CEO GUY KONSBRUCK TO STEP DOWN ON 30 JUNE 2027
announcements.insight: CEO Guy Konsbruck steps down in June 2027. This leadership change follows recent production updates and acquisition evaluations.

announcements.headline: Afarak Group: Production report Q3 2026
announcements.insight: Afarak Group SE released its Q3 2026 production report. This operational update follows the July evaluation of a potential metal acquisition.

announcements.headline: AFARAK GROUP SE AND ITS GROUP COMPANIES ARE EVALUATING POTENTIAL ACQUISITION OF THE METAL FACTORY OF ABS SISAK D.O.O. LOCATED IS SISAK, CROATIA.
announcements.insight: Afarak Group SE is evaluating a potential acquisition of a metal factory in Croatia. This follows its annual general meeting resolutions in June 2026.
